<a id="executor-executor-generation-start"></a>

### executor.generation.start

Only the dedicated `understand_book_executor` Executor may call this tool. After consuming all input, confirm the final batch and create or replay its semantic attempt. Only GENERATE grants candidate generation: use its output_contract, opaque_session_ref and candidate_sink_ref. The generation session can differ from the delivery session. Lost responses replay the same active attempt; stale_generation_session requires Driver recovery, not reuse of an old sink. Follow WAIT/DONE without generating. Examples use test-session refs; replace refs and ordinals with the exact values from your current handoff or tool results.

**来源符号**：[packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts:BUILD_EXECUTOR_TOOL_CONTRACTS_V3](../packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts)；[skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts:createBuildExecutorMcpSession](../skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts)。

**完整契约**：[tool-contracts.json](tool-contracts.json)，JSON Pointer：`/executor/0`。

**发布注解**

```json
{
  "readOnlyHint": false,
  "destructiveHint": false,
  "idempotentHint": true,
  "openWorldHint": false
}
```

**输入参数**

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型与约束 | 语义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | 是 | const="automatic_build_executor_generation_start_request.v3" | — |
| `opaque_session_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=75; pattern="^absession1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Delivery session ref whose complete input you consumed. |
| `generation_input_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=73; pattern="^abinput1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Input ref paired with that delivery session. |
| `confirmed_through_ordinal` | 是 | type="integer"; minimum=0 | last_ordinal of the consumed batch with final_for_generation=true; this confirms the final batch and requests the generation grant. |

顶层输入拒绝未声明字段。

<a id="executor-executor-input-next"></a>

### executor.input.next

Only the dedicated `understand_book_executor` Executor may call this tool. Read the next ordered INPUT_BATCH. Start with DELIVER_INPUT.next_request, consume every chunk in ordinal order, then acknowledge a non-final batch by its last_ordinal to request the next batch. Repeating the current request replays its batch. Delivery and acknowledgement update the session ledger. When final_for_generation=true, confirm the final last_ordinal with executor.generation.start instead of input.next. Examples show first read and non-final acknowledgement (the DSH fixture delivers one chunk per batch). Examples use test-session refs; replace refs and ordinals with the exact values from your current handoff or tool results.

**来源符号**：[packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts:BUILD_EXECUTOR_TOOL_CONTRACTS_V3](../packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts)；[skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts:createBuildExecutorMcpSession](../skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts)。

**完整契约**：[tool-contracts.json](tool-contracts.json)，JSON Pointer：`/executor/1`。

**发布注解**

```json
{
  "readOnlyHint": false,
  "destructiveHint": false,
  "idempotentHint": true,
  "openWorldHint": false
}
```

**输入参数**

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型与约束 | 语义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | 是 | const="automatic_build_executor_input_next_request.v4" | — |
| `opaque_session_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=75; pattern="^absession1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Delivery session ref from the current DELIVER_INPUT.next_request. |
| `generation_input_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=73; pattern="^abinput1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Input ref from that same delivery; keep it paired with its session. |
| `ack_through_ordinal` | 按分支／可选 | type="integer"; minimum=0 | Last ordinal actually consumed in the preceding non-final batch. Omit for first read; on resume copy next_request exactly. Never acknowledge the final batch here. |

顶层输入拒绝未声明字段。

<a id="executor-executor-open"></a>

### executor.open

Only the dedicated `understand_book_executor` Executor may call this tool. Open or resume the assigned handoff. DELIVER_INPUT provides an input_manifest and a ready-to-call next_request; WAIT provides retry_after_ms; DONE is the code-owned terminal status. Reopen the same handoff on a replacement connection to resume unconfirmed input or rehydrate an active generation. A stale_generation_session/lease_expired requires Driver recovery and a new handoff on a fresh connection. Examples use test-session refs; replace refs and ordinals with the exact values from your current handoff or tool results.

**来源符号**：[packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts:BUILD_EXECUTOR_TOOL_CONTRACTS_V3](../packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts)；[skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts:createBuildExecutorMcpSession](../skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts)。

**完整契约**：[tool-contracts.json](tool-contracts.json)，JSON Pointer：`/executor/2`。

**发布注解**

```json
{
  "readOnlyHint": false,
  "destructiveHint": false,
  "idempotentHint": true,
  "openWorldHint": false
}
```

**输入参数**

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型与约束 | 语义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | 是 | const="automatic_build_executor_open_request.v3" | — |
| `opaque_handoff_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=75; pattern="^abhandoff1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Copy the complete assigned opaque handoff ref; its record version does not change this request version. |

顶层输入拒绝未声明字段。

<a id="executor-executor-submit_candidate"></a>

### executor.submit_candidate

Only the dedicated `understand_book_executor` Executor may call this tool. Submit one JSON value matching the current GENERATE.output_contract, within its candidate and serialized-request budgets. Copy both refs from that GENERATE, including after recovery. Code writes the private sink, validates and returns the next action or DONE status without echoing the candidate. Candidate submission alone is not proof of acceptance. candidate_sink_unavailable permits replay of the identical candidate on the same active attempt; lease_expired requires Driver recovery. The empty graph example is a valid synthetic Pass1 candidate, not a universal output shape. Examples use test-session refs; replace refs and ordinals with the exact values from your current handoff or tool results.

**来源符号**：[packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts:BUILD_EXECUTOR_TOOL_CONTRACTS_V3](../packages/core/src/build-executor-tool-contract.ts)；[skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts:createBuildExecutorMcpSession](../skills/build/build-executor-mcp.ts)。

**完整契约**：[tool-contracts.json](tool-contracts.json)，JSON Pointer：`/executor/3`。

**发布注解**

```json
{
  "readOnlyHint": false,
  "destructiveHint": false,
  "idempotentHint": true,
  "openWorldHint": false
}
```

**输入参数**

| 字段 | 必填 | 类型与约束 | 语义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | 是 | const="automatic_build_executor_candidate_submit.v3" | — |
| `opaque_session_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=75; pattern="^absession1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Generation session ref from the current GENERATE, not DELIVER_INPUT. |
| `candidate_sink_ref` | 是 | type="string"; maxLength=72; pattern="^absink1_[a-f0-9]{64}$" | Private sink ref paired with that current generation session; a replacement generation supplies a new pair. |
| `candidate` | 是 | oneOf: type="null" / type="boolean" / type="number" / type="string" / type="array" / type="object"; additionalProperties=true | Structured JSON value satisfying the delivered semantic prompt and output_contract. Pass the value directly, not a filename or a JSON-encoded string. |

顶层输入拒绝未声明字段。

### active

**状态输入**

```json

}
```

完整投影：`/tutor_states/active`。

Select one source-grounded move after reading original text this turn with book tools. Supply target with learning_focus, expected_performance, capability, exact source_bindings (start_lid, end_lid; omit source_id/source_revision to use the runtime-bound current source), and optional object_refs. object_ids may be empty when no applicable formal objects exist. If using available objects, read them with material and include their exact revisions in target.object_refs; missing cognitive material does not block teaching. trace rereads private delivered facts. Explicit direct explanation overrides guided inquiry. Select with operation=select and a move; final delivery presents it. Optional presentation must already be delivered in this turn. Optional assessment freezes private criteria before delivery. assess evaluates an existing formal response in one isolated model call; understanding reads evidence; evidence proposes a sourced ungraded interpretation. Page calculations never assess correctness. Private keys and help must not enter public text. No direct mastery updates. Examples use an average-speed teaching fixture, not learner facts. Replace its content, locations and references with actual material and events from this turn; read the source before selecting or interpreting.

## 已知限制

- 表面目录代表当前源码定义，实际运行还受权限、材料能力、状态与工具暴露计划约束。新状态分支应扩展原 Tutor 契约场景，生成器继续消费这些场景。
- 未发布示例、annotations 或 outputSchema 的条目已明确标注。它们的类型化扩展按实际消费需求推进。
- reader.note 返回 EXISTING 时已有笔记仍有效，但现有 Goal reader_action 完成判断可能缺少创建 effect；见 [TO5 已知限制](performance/tool-usability/to5/README.md#已知限制)。
- 本文验证契约与生成一致性；真实 Agent 选用、完成率和成本收益由 TO14 验收。
